name: Mixpanel
description: Query and analyze your Mixpanel data directly in Claude. Run segmentation, funnel, and retention analyses, explore your event taxonomy, manage Lexicon metadata, analyze session replays, and resolve data quality issues. With Mixpanel as persistent context, Claude can reason about your product data alongside your code, documents, and decisions, across any conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mixpanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mixpanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mixpanel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mixpanel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mixpanel lists 20 MCP tools, including Get-Projects, Get-Events, Get-Event-Details, Get-Property-Names, Get-Property-Values, Edit-Event, Edit-Property, Create-Tag, Rename-Tag, Delete-Tag, Dismiss-Issues, and Get-Issues.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mixpanel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mixpanel in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Mixpanel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mixpanel is developed by Mixpanel. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
